notes: Corrected: the copula of the first colon was moved from `חַיִּים` to the `בְּ` heading the fronted prepositional predicate. Rule 49's first sentence governs, and its closing paragraph excludes the nominal-predicate reading because no nominal predicate stands in the clause — `חַיִּים` is the postposed subject.

The chapter's other fronted prepositional predicates (PRO.16.1 and PRO.16.33) are already aligned this way, so the accepted reading here was the outlier and followed the ASV's English word order rather than the Hebrew clause.
